However, crowding_z 1.77 flags the name as crowded, and the track_record shows directional accuracy of only 0.366 — so this is a size-down caution, not alpha. The rotation is narrow (1 of 22 eligible) and non-directional, so I lean on the trend-gate leg only as a de-risking context, not a return forecast.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal has the highest momentum rank (0.735) but fails the trend-gate (eligible=false, durability 0.25, mixed hurst, breadth 0.3). The low breadth and mixed trend health suggest the rank is an attention spike, not sustainable leadership, and the rotation leader/challenger margin of 0.027 is too tight to call a confirmed handoff. I lean avoid on the premise that the trend-gate is the one validated edge (even if weak on this market) and Coal fails it.
evidence: durability_bar=0.25, hurst_tag=mixed, breadth=0.3 — weak trend cohesion
rotation.margin=0.027 — no confirmed leadership handoff to Coal
theses.dissent: Coal's rank #1 with positive score could be an early-stage rotation forming; if the trend-gate eventually opens, the avoid call misses the early move. Also, the backtest says the gate doesn't even work well here, so failing it may be less meaningful than in other markets.
